meta_title: MoreClock: world clocks for your Mac
meta_description: Add time zones to your macOS menu bar with MoreClock. Choose a city, add a flag, and set the date and time display for each clock.
og_description: Your cities, right in the menu bar. A native macOS app with a separate clock for every time zone.
app_description: A native macOS menu bar app that displays a separate clock for each time zone, with optional flags, dates, seconds and bold text.
language_switch_aria: View this website in Simplified Chinese
hero_lead: Keep the time in the places that matter, right in your menu bar. Give each clock its own city, flag and date.
clocks_title: Choose a city for each clock
clocks_lead: Search for a place or a time zone, then give it a name. MoreClock adds a separate item to your menu bar for every clock.
language_note: Change the app language in MoreClock or in macOS System Settings.
display_lead: Show the date in Tokyo while keeping London to hours and minutes. Each clock has its own display settings.
date_lead: Add the weekday, the date, or both. Seconds and bold text are optional for every clock.
language_lead: MoreClock follows your Mac’s language, with English and 12 translations, including Arabic and Persian layouts.
screenshot_alt: MoreClock General settings in Simplified Chinese, showing launch at login and the language picker
faq_compat_answer: macOS 26 or later, on Apple silicon and Intel.
faq_warning_question: Why might macOS show a warning?
faq_warning_answer: This release is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized.
faq_settings_question: How do I open clock settings?
faq_settings_answer: Choose Settings from a clock’s menu, or reopen MoreClock from Finder or Spotlight.
faq_arrange_answer: Command-drag to reorder. Drag a clock out of the menu bar to hide it.
faq_shortcuts_answer: Yes. Add, remove, show and hide clocks, change time zones and read the time.
features: Separate menu bar clocks for multiple time zones
Automatic country or region flag prefixes
Optional weekday, date, seconds and bold text
English and 12 translations with Arabic and Persian right-to-left layouts
geo_intro: MoreClock is a native macOS menu bar app for displaying clocks in multiple time zones.
geo_website_languages: The website has English and Simplified Chinese editions. These website languages are separate from the app's English and 12 translations.
geo_facts: Architecture: one universal app for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Download: a 2,974,465-byte DMG hosted on GitHub Releases.
Each configured clock appears as a separate menu bar item.
A clock can have a custom name, a prefix such as a country flag, optional seconds, optional bold text, and a date with the weekday, calendar date, or both.
Clock names appear in Settings, the clock menu and Shortcuts. The menu bar displays the prefix, optional date and time.
Selecting a city or time zone fills an empty prefix with its country or region flag. Custom prefixes are preserved.
Time formatting follows the Mac's 12/24-hour setting. Dates follow the user's locale and calendar, in the clock's own time zone.
Settings includes General, Clocks and About tabs. General includes launch at login and app language.

Interface languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Arabic and Persian. Arabic and Persian support right-to-left layout.
Shortcuts actions can add, remove, show and hide clocks, edit clock configuration, and read times.
Command-drag a clock to reorder it. Drag it out of the menu bar to hide it. Open MoreClock again from Finder or Spotlight to return to Settings.
The v1.0.1 download is ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple. macOS may block first launch. Consult Apple's app-opening guidance before choosing to open it.
The website is a product preview; its interactive controls do not configure the installed macOS app.
